## File: facebookresearch_looptool/extern/wasm-micro-runtime/test-tools/IoT-APP-Store-Demo/wasm_django/devices/views.py

Prompts

```
['query all connected IoT devices via TCP socket on port 8889 and render device list', 'query installed apps on a specific IoT device by IP and port via TCP socket', 'install a WASM applet on an IoT device by sending an install command over TCP', 'uninstall a WASM applet from an IoT device by sending an uninstall command over TCP', 'upload a new WASM app file to the static upload directory and add it to the app store']
```

Usage

```
{'query_all_devices': 'query all connected IoT devices via TCP socket on port 8889 and render device list', 'query_device_apps': 'query installed apps on a specific IoT device by IP and port via TCP socket', 'install_wasm_app': 'install a WASM applet on an IoT device by sending an install command over TCP', 'uninstall_wasm_app': 'uninstall a WASM applet from an IoT device by sending an uninstall command over TCP', 'upload_wasm_app': 'upload a new WASM app file to the static upload directory and add it to the app store'}
```
